summary: Ticketplus Ltd., a NYSE American-listed Chilean live-entertainment platform, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its September 30, 2026 press release announcing the engagement of Fernando Mass Tar, former CorpBanca CEO, as Lead Strategic Advisor for LATAM Regional Strategy and Governance. The advisory role is unpaid in nature and carries no compensatory terms, equity stake, or contractual economics disclosed. No board recommendation, premium, price per share, or transaction mechanics are stated. The release references the prior Autoentrada acquisition in Argentina detailed in a September 22, 2026 filing. No current special-situation transaction is being effected by this announcement.
